concept: A head-to-head duel on warm technical paper. oh-my-pi's own dark terminal panels sit inset on a bright editorial page. The film states a stance (line numbers lie), shows the flaw, forms the content-hash anchor, then stages the money shot: a file shifts underneath two pending edits and the line-number edit corrupts while the content-hash edit re-finds its target and locks in clean. Close reframes the stance as a builder's credit. The picture carries the argument; the words just name it.
money_shot_note: Scene 5, the split duel (side_by_side_flip). At the same instant the file shifts, the left (line-number) edit lands wrong and corrupts in red, the right (content-hash) edit re-locks in rose. It is the peak because it is the ONE frame that proves WHY content-anchoring wins - shown, not told. The reserved dip transition and the single foley click land here.
transition_strategy: Hard cuts throughout (editorial, motion carries through the cut). The ONE reserved transition (dip) fires only on the cut INTO the money shot (scene 4 to 5), a quick luminance dip that snaps into the duel. No swipe on any other cut.
music_direction: A measured, precise bed with a clear onset to snap the duel cut to. Foley: click_minimal, a single precise click on the lock at the money beat - the mechanism you can hear. No per-cut whoosh.
